title: Perfect!!!
text: Perfect!!!. Finally a peeler that really works! I have the old all metal peelers and they dont seem as sharp as they used to. I got some new ones with a coated handle but they seem too loose while trying to peel anything so I am constantly having to stop to clean the blade off. Getting fed up with things not working, I ordered these. I was skeptical about these thinking they might just be like all the others. I was wrong! These are so sharp! I love the red and green ones. One swipe and the whole peel was off the cucumber and off if the blade. I was so happy that I finally found something that worked. I looked at the design and figured out that the black arm the blade is attached to must make the diference in holding the blade better. Old ones dont have this piece and the blades turn too much like they afe loose. I now have 2 perfect peelers. The 3 rd one..is a wide one and I havent figured that one out yet lol. Great peelers highly recommend them! They each come with a blade guard for safety and storage. Also comes with a cleaning brush as well.
